prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a preset pet friend or generate a custom companion.", "Instant Desktop Sync"]
1: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet", "Linking an account keeps your pet saved securely in the cloud across reinstalls.", "Cloud Pet Recovery Active"]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Companion Workspace", "Configuring graphics and background desktop permissions for your pet.", "Checking desktop display overlay permissions", "Compiling companion animation frames"]
3: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Learn the essential controls to manage, hide, or interact with your companion anytime.", "Quick Command: Right-click pet for controls menu"]
4: ["Setup takes under 2 minutes to complete"]
5: ["Official Companion Certificate", "Complete registration to spawn your companion on desktop.", "Verified Desktop Registry Companion"]
6: ["Your Companion Is Hatching...", "Feel free to switch apps. We will send a desktop notification when ready!"]
7: ["Your pet progress and memory are linked permanently to this account."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Bring your desktop workspace to life with an interactive virtual pet."]
9: ["Upload Clear Photos for Best Customization", "Use well-lit frontal photos to ensure accurate custom pet generation.", "Avoid blurry images or dark background lighting."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos of the user
